premises.text: Companies share data with far more vendors than they realize, complicating compliance with privacy laws.
premises.evidence_span: the average company thinks they share data with about 40 different companies, but in fact, they share with an astounding 750.

premises.text: There is no easy way for companies to track data sharing and comply with privacy obligations.
premises.evidence_span: there is no easy way to track what's happening with all of that data, and there's no easy way for companies to comply with their privacy obligations.

premises.text: Osano's platform helps companies identify suitable vendors and comply with privacy laws.
premises.evidence_span: Osano's data privacy platform makes it easy for companies to identify which vendors are best to work with, to comply with laws like GDPR, California's privacy law, and other upcoming regulations.

premises.text: Osano provides a comprehensive view of vendor privacy practices through a proprietary dataset.
premises.evidence_span: utilizing our proprietary data set of 7,000 different vendors, Osano provides a 360-degree view of each vendor's privacy practices.

premises.text: Osano assigns an objective score to vendors to help companies assess risk.
premises.evidence_span: Osano assigns an objective score to each vendor, making it easy for companies to identify where they have risk.

premises.text: Osano automates compliance with a simple code integration for websites.
premises.evidence_span: with one line of code, websites can immediately become compliant with the laws of 40 different countries.

premises.text: Osano captures and logs data about vendors for customer visibility.
premises.evidence_span: Osano customers can automagically log in and view all of the vendors they're sharing data with, look at their privacy practices, and see how they rank.

premises.text: The market for data privacy software is rapidly growing.
premises.evidence_span: By 2023, companies will be spending more than $3.3 billion per year on data privacy software.

premises.text: Osano targets companies underserved by expensive compliance solutions.
premises.evidence_span: Osano is targeting the 90 percent of companies who are not served by the expensive point solutions.

premises.text: Osano has a large user base for its free compliance product.
premises.evidence_span: Osano has 750,000 users of our free compliance product.

value.text: Companies can easily manage data privacy and compliance obligations.
value.evidence_span: Data privacy and compliance used to be a complicated manual process. Osano makes it easy.
